items.headline: ESPN's Taylor Davis previews UK vs. Vandy, analyzes Ole Miss upset
items.description: Davis dives into Vanderbilt's journey to find its rhythm while discussing No. 15 Kentucky's confidence going into Week 8, and dissects Ole Miss' dominant upset over Mizzou.

items.headline: Can Week 8 up the ante again with more upsets and drama?
items.description: With plenty of SEC drama last week, could Week 8 bring even more chaos?

items.headline: Keys to victory as No. 12 Kentucky welcomes Vanderbilt
items.description: SEC Network's Gene Chizik breaks down why the Wildcats have been so tough to beat this season and discusses what the Commodores must do to steal a win on the road.

items.headline: College Football Playoff Bubble Watch after Week 7
items.description: A conference-by-conference look at who is contending for the playoff, who's close and who's out.

items.headline: Doering, Burns reveal their SECTM Week 7 Power Rankings
items.description: After a Week 7 full of marquee victories and defeats across the conference, SEC This Morning's Chris Doering ranks what went wrong while Peter Burns focuses on the positives.

items.headline: Vanderbilt visits No. 12 Kentucky in SEC matchup
items.description: Vanderbilt (3-4) at No. 12 Kentucky (6-1), Oct. 24 at 7:30 p.m. EDT.
